products.summary: Industry-leading noise cancellation with excellent sound quality. Comfortable for extended wear with 30-hour battery life. The XM5 is a refinement of the beloved XM4 line.
Bose's flagship with immersive audio and excellent comfort. Strong noise cancellation with a more neutral sound profile than Sony. CustomTune technology adapts to your ears.

head_to_head.noise_cancellation: Sony WH-1000XM5 - Slightly edge, especially for low-frequency noise
head_to_head.sound_quality: Tie - Sony has more bass, Bose more neutral and spatial
head_to_head.comfort: Bose QC Ultra - Wider range of head sizes, lighter clamping
head_to_head.build_quality: Bose QC Ultra - More premium materials
head_to_head.value_for_money: Sony WH-1000XM5 - $30 cheaper with longer battery
head_to_head.portability: Bose QC Ultra - Folds flat, better case
head_to_head.features: Sony WH-1000XM5 - Multipoint, speak-to-chat, better app

reasoning: Based on your preference for durability and performance with moderate price sensitivity, the Sony WH-1000XM5 offers the best overall package. Its 30-hour battery life, superior noise cancellation, and lower price point align well with your priorities. However, if comfort during extended wear is your top concern, the Bose QC Ultra is worth the premium.
